About the studio

Half Past Moon Studio is a small independent studio making games on Roblox. Our name comes from the hour when ideas show up: half past midnight, with the moon high overhead. It’s also the hour players stay up a little late for a game they love.

We don’t stick to one genre. Some of our games will be spooky, some cozy, some creative, and some made for a party. What ties them together is care: clear rules, fair play, details worth finding, and fun that teens and grown-ups can share.

We’re just getting started. We want to become a studio people trust for great games in any genre, and we’d rather earn that by shipping than by saying so.

What we believe

  • ☾

    Fun first

    Whatever the genre, it should feel good from the first minute.

  • ✦

    Every game, its own rules

    A cozy game and a scary game shouldn’t feel the same, and ours won’t.

  • ◉

    Reward the curious

    Details are placed on purpose, so a second look turns up something new.
